titel: Open EU procedure for detailed design and construction of a new ice arena in San Vendemiano
kurzbeschreibung: New construction of an ice sports hall including detailed design and construction services in San Vendemiano.
umfang: Integrated contract for preparation of the detailed design and execution of the construction works for a new ice arena on the site of the former powder factory. The notice does not contain specific information on GFA, spectator capacity, spans, roof structure or other technical parameters. Estimated contract value excluding VAT: 8,971,084.70 EUR. Execution period: 545 days.
leistungen: Appalto integrato: detailed design and construction services for the new build of a sports facility / ice sports hall.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Sports building with potentially long-span hall and roof structure, therefore generally a good fit for sbp.
• Integrated contract explicitly includes detailed design in addition to construction services, creating a relevant planning component.
• Ice sports halls often require large column-free areas and technically demanding structures.
• The project volume is substantial and economically attractive for a municipal sports building.
• A limiting factor is that the notice does not contain specific information on spans, structural system or architectural distinctiveness.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the tender notice; the estimated contract value excluding VAT is stated for design and construction as a whole, not explicitly only for cost groups 300+400.
honorar_erklaerung: No separate design fee stated. As this is an integrated contract for detailed design and construction, the fee share attributable to structural design cannot be reliably derived from the notice.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the notice via the European Single Procurement Document. The TED notice does not state specific requirements regarding references, disciplines or minimum numbers.
auftraggeber: COMUNE DI SAN VENDEMIANO, 31020 San Vendemiano, Italy, contact: Arch. Elena Mulotto, e-mail: sualavori@provincia.treviso.it, tel.: 04226565. Procurement documents: www.provincia.treviso.it
notes: TED subtype described as competition, but in fact contract notice for construction works under an open procedure. Submission electronically via https://www.ariaspa.it/ in Italian. Further contracting authority: Provincia di Treviso, Via Cal Di Breda 116, 31100 Treviso, Italy, contact: Massimiliano Lorenzon, maslorenzon@provincia.treviso.it.
